'''Kor Jiramma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Kor Jiramma system/Legends|Kor Jiramma system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Huloon system/Legends|Huloon system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kor Jiramma was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Jiramma]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and its proximity to the throneworld [[Kor Vanderijar]] was a reason for partnership between the Jiramma and the [[Vanderijar]] clan.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Jiramma was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
